announcements.headline: Board Appointments

announcements.headline: Q2 Trading Statement
announcements.insight: LONDON & QUADRANT HOUSING TRUST issues a Q2 trading update following its June sale and August board changes. Shareholders should monitor for strategic direction shifts post-disposal.

announcements.insight: Audited Financial Statements are released alongside a Group Board Change. This follows the earlier decision to double resident representation on the board in August.

announcements.headline: L&Q doubles resident representation on Group Board
announcements.insight: L&Q doubles resident representation on its Group Board. This governance change follows the recent sale of L&Q PRS Co Ltd to MSREI for £1,045m in June.

announcements.headline: Sale of L&Q PRS Co Ltd to MSREI for £1,045m
